items.title: All Around the World: Music Trivia
items.description: During Multicultural Week, I hosted an International Music Trivia Challenge in the library at lunch — playing a mix of songs from around the world and challenging people to name the title, the language, and the country each one came from. It turned into a proper competition, with plenty of deliberation over every clue.

images.alt: Rithu holding a microphone and speaking in front of a projected "All Around the World Music Trivia" title slide
Rithu gesturing toward the room while hosting the music trivia challenge
